newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share trading halted by technical glitch.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share trading halted by technical glitch.

text.p: Singapore share trading was halted by a technical breakdown in the Stock Exchange of Singapore central computer just before the close Tuesday afternoon, dealers said.
They said the system broke down about 30 minutes before the official close of trading at 0900 GMT.
"We just could not key in any trades," said one dealer.
Trading on the Singapore bourse is all electronic.
A Stock Exchange of Singapore official said its technical department was checking on the breakdown and could not give further details.
